fieldValues.title: Programme owner in Programme coordination
fieldValues.summary: The programme owner (today the owner of SemanticOps and muDemocracy), steering many agents across many repositories, who must judge what matters without reading everything.
goals: See what is in flight and what is stuck at a glance
Receive only the decisions they can judge, framed at their level
Know that closed work really landed
jobs: Ratify or set aside decisions in a session
Delegate work to groups and receive their reports
Notice work that bypasses the agreed process
fieldValues.needs: One honest picture of the flow, decisions sized to their judgement, and rules stated once and enforced.
